# Architecture documentation instructions

- Label unapproved choices as proposals and record their validation status.
- Keep diagrams consistent with the described/implemented system; do not depict planned infrastructure as deployed.
- Every ADR must include context, options, decision, rationale, consequences, risks, and reconsideration conditions.
- Preserve the Game → Platform / Game → Release → Physical Copy distinctions and explicit ownership/privacy boundaries.
- State migration, validation, indexing, uniqueness, data portability, and provider licensing assumptions when relevant.
- Escalate paid, difficult-to-reverse, or materially security-sensitive decisions for human approval.
